segments.text: THat this part and the next, are Imperfect, and so much only is written as I might, and not as I would, I need not excuse to thee, if thou know me and where and when I live. But some of that which is wanting if thou desire thou maist find, 1. In my Universal Concord; 2. In my Christian Concord; 3. In our Agreement for Catechising and my Reformed Pastor; 4. In the Reformed Lyturgie, offered to the Commissioned Bishops at the Savoy.
